384:t_002:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$バルビエル$$ adds the power of a $$スフィア$$ to that to induce powerful hypnosis, but a copy that only imitates the form won't work on us!」

384:t_002:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'm well aware of that! ...But how will the small fry riding machines with sloppy airtight sealing fare?」

384:t_004:0.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Destroy! I'll destroy it all!!」

384:t_005:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「This is bad! They've been struck down by the scorpion's poison!」

384:t_005:1.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Don't stand in our way!!」

384:t_005:2.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Anyone who gets in the way gets crushed!!」

384:t_005:4.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Like this, there's no way we can evacuate the citizens!」

384:t_005:6.en:
$$五飛$$
「So we have no choice but to stop them by force...!」

384:t_005:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Can you do it, in this situation!」

384:t_006:0.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「So this is the main attack!」

384:t_006:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「This puts us in a pincer between the Resistance and the $$サイデリアル$$!」

384:t_006:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「But we have no choice but to do it...!」

384:t_006:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, incapacitate the Resistance machines! Do not shoot them down under any circumstances!」

384:t_006:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「In this situation, that's a seriously tough order!」

384:t_006:5.en:
$$マオ$$
「We do it anyway! If we crush the Resistance here, we're playing right into $$ギルター$$'s hands!」

384:t_006:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Do try your best, $c. I think I'll indulge in watching from a safe seat above.」

384:t_007:2.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I won't let that man have his way!」

384:t_007:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$! We will break your trap without fail!」

384:t_008:0.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「The Resistance has been incapacitated!」

384:t_008:1.en:
$$クェス$$
「All that's left is to take down the base!」

384:t_008:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like we've hooked something much bigger!」

384:t_009:0.en:
$$エマ$$
「At this rate it'll turn into a war of attrition!」

384:t_009:1.en:
$$フォウ$$
「The only way is to take the base down, even at the cost of some sacrifices...!」

384:t_009:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like we've hooked something much bigger!」

384:t_010:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you finally showed up, $$バルビエル$$!」

384:t_011:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What is this sorry state?」

384:t_011:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I am defending the 24th $$ターミナル・ベース$$, and I intend to wipe out the $c very shortly!」

384:t_011:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「For one who received the scorpion's poison from $$サルディアス$$, you don't seem to have achieved much.」

384:t_011:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Save your pathetic farce for later, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$!」

384:t_011:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you've come here, then I'll be your opponent!」

384:t_011:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...So you've noticed, it seems, $$セツコ$$.」

384:t_011:9.en:
$$シン$$
「What are you talking about, $$セツコ$$!?」

384:t_011:10.en:
$$セツコ$$
「While $$ランド$$'s $$スフィア$$ is well matched with $$ストラウス$$'s $$スフィア$$...」

384:t_011:11.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$'s $$スフィア$$ is a poor match for mine.」

384:t_011:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「To completely defeat an awakened $$スフィア・リアクター$$, you need a $$スフィア$$ that's a poor match for theirs...」

384:t_011:13.en:
$$万丈$$
「To defeat the $$偽りの黒羊$$, $$アイム・ライアード$$, $$アサキム$$ used the $$知りたがる山羊$$ $$スフィア$$.」

384:t_011:14.en:
$$ランド$$
「I see! So $$バルビエル$$ was thinking of dealing first with $$セツコ$$, who could beat him!」

384:t_011:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're a bigger coward than you look, $$バルビエル$$!」

384:t_011:16.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, second-rate Reactor. $$スフィア$$ compatibility means nothing in the face of overwhelming power.」

384:t_011:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「And you lot aren't the ones I have business with.」

384:t_011:20.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$n... I'll ask you one last time. Come with us.」

384:t_011:24.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So he's gone with the simplest way of using her.」

384:t_011:25.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If she'd come out onto the battlefield under mind control, there would still have been ways to deal with it, but...」

384:t_011:26.en:
$$アムロ$$
「There's nothing we can do like this...!」

384:t_011:29.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Crushed by despair, are you...? Then I'll give you hope.」

384:t_011:30.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you submit to us, I'll release $$西条涼音$$ and return the area you want to the Earth side.」

384:t_011:32.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Let's see... While I'm at it, I'm willing to return five people of your choosing from among the humans we're holding.」

384:t_011:33.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$, $$ナナリー・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$, $$カガリ・ユラ・アスハ$$, $$マリナ・イスマイール$$... those would be my recommendations.」

384:t_011:37.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now choose, $n. Hope for the future, or irreversible despair.」
